# Synthetic source for quotation tests

This is hand-written test input, not a real paper or a source-verification receipt.
The PDF identities and page indices in `IR.json` are synthetic locators; no PDF,
Zotero library, Vault registration, application, or network service is accessed.
The revised IR uses all four reference-tree branches. Its three additional entries
declare unavailable source coverage, not invented paper facts; the two source
sentences and their expected excerpts remain unchanged.
